item.hha_void.void_helmet.lore2: Set: Child of the Night — at night and in the End: invisibility, night vision, regeneration
item.hha_void.void_helmet.lore3: Set: Emergency Rift — below %s hearts: teleport away from everyone + full invis %ss (%ss cooldown)
item.hha_void.void_helmet.lore4: Set: Full Invis — invisibility hides your armor too
item.hha_void.void_chestplate.lore2: Meteor Strike [%s] — homing meteors + void comet (%ss cooldown)
item.hha_void.void_chestplate.lore3: Set: Void Link — every hit arcs at 1/3 to 3/3 strength to the target's allies
item.hha_void.void_chestplate.lore4: Set: Void Collapse [%s] — drags every enemy within %s blocks in, flings them up and slams them down; you gain Strength + Invisibility (%ss cooldown)
item.hha_void.void_leggings.lore1: Void Pounce [%s] — teleport above the weakest creature within %s blocks + upward boost (%ss cooldown)
item.hha_void.void_leggings.lore2: Set: Shared Gifts — your positive effects arc to trusted players within %s blocks
item.hha_void.void_leggings.lore3: Set: The Void catches you — falling into the void teleports you to your spawn point instead of killing you
item.hha_void.void_boots.lore3: Void Step [2× %s] — teleport where you look, through walls (%s blocks), never downward (%ss cooldown)
item.hha_void.void_sword.lore2: Void Shards [%s] — throws one of 6 orbiting shards: jumps from enemy to enemy and returns, %s damage per hit
item.hha_void.void_mace.lore1: Sky Launch [%s] — the mace hurls you skyward (%ss cooldown)
item.hha_void.void_mace.lore2: Then: shockwave — your next mace hit strikes all enemies within %s blocks at full damage
hha_void.msg.void_rescue: The void swallows you — and spits you out back home
hha_void.msg.escape: Emergency rift — the nothing tore you away!
hha_void.boss.name: Vael
hha_void.boss.line.summon: The lectern opens the file. Somewhere in the nothing, someone turns a page.
hha_void.boss.line.awaken: Everything that is was borrowed from the void: every light, every breath, every name. I am not your enemy. I am the day the bill arrives.
hha_void.boss.line.idle0: You call it life. The ledger calls it credit.
hha_void.boss.line.idle1: The void does not hate you. It only waits for what is its own.
hha_void.boss.line.idle2: Stars do not go out. They repay.
hha_void.boss.line.idle3: Every wound is an installment. You have been paying all your life.
hha_void.boss.line.idle4: You fight like someone who believes this belongs to them.
hha_void.boss.line.idle5: Before you there was nothing, and it was perfect. You are the shortfall.
hha_void.boss.line.phase2: The reminders are over. You borrowed time, and I am seizing it.
hha_void.boss.line.phase3: Forgiveness is the final gift. After it, nothing remains that could be owed.
hha_void.boss.line.seizure: That is not yours. It never was.
hha_void.boss.line.sweep: I am striking you from the books. Lift your feet while you still have them.
hha_void.boss.line.singularity: Look. This is what a balanced account looks like.
hha_void.boss.line.remission: The Remission. Stand behind a pillar, if you still believe in walls.
hha_void.boss.line.death_final: The debt is not settled. It has only been transferred to you.
hha_void.boss.title.phase3.sub: After this, nothing can be owed
hha_void.boss.msg.seized: Seized! Your item briefly belongs to the Creditor.
hha_void.boss.msg.survived: The Remission passed you by. For now.
hha_void.boss.msg.placed: The Tribunal stands. The Creditor wakes when someone stands before the lectern.
hha_void.boss.msg.rearmed: You acknowledge your debt once more. The lectern stirs.
hha_void.boss.book.page1:
THE LEDGER OF THE VOID

Before the first light there was nothing, and nothing was missing.

Then came the borrowing.
hha_void.boss.book.page2: Every thing that is carries a debt: the space it takes from the void. The stone owes its weight, the flame its warmth, you your name.
hha_void.boss.book.page3: The living call this passing death, and fear it. We call it repayment. It is no loss. It is the settling of accounts.
hha_void.boss.book.page4: I do not hate. A creditor does not hate. I only come when it is time, and I take only what never belonged to anyone.
hha_void.boss.book.page5:
Whoever reads this has defeated me, and so has inherited my claims.

You will see: they are heavy.

— Vael
hha_void.boss.line.death_true: Then... write it down. Someone has to carry it.
hha_void.boss.line.rise: Paid? With what? With borrowed life?
hha_void.boss.line.phase4: The void has no creditors. It only has me. And now everything comes due, even the sky.
hha_void.boss.line.sky: Even that up there was only borrowed.
hha_void.cut.intro1: Everything that is has borrowed from the void.
hha_void.cut.intro2: I am not your enemy. I am the day the bill arrives.
hha_void.cut.rebirth2: The void has no creditors. It only has me.
hha_void.boss.title.closed.sub: The sky is yours again. For now.
hha_void.boss.line.rain: Even the sky was on credit. It is falling due.
